recent_en: Feytech announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding and issued another announcement on 17 November 2026. Earlier, subsidiary FT Assembly entered into an assembly agreement with related party Evolvelectric Motors on 28 September, a recurrent related party transaction. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 20.7% year-on-year and net profit increased 40.6% year-on-year.
notable_en: The company signed a memorandum of understanding on 17 November 2026.
Subsidiary FT Assembly entered into an assembly agreement with Evolvelectric Motors, a recurrent related party transaction with an estimated aggregate value of at least RM1 million.
risks_en: The assembly agreement is a related party transaction; Evolvelectric Motors is related to substantial shareholder Mr. Go Yoong Chang.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 38,442,000, up 20.7% year-on-year and down 1.3% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 4,251,000, up 40.6% year-on-year and up 5.5% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 11.1%, higher than 10.3% in the previous quarter.
